reserves.name: Apollo Crypto managed yield strategy NAV
reserves.issuerOrObligor: Midas Software GmbH (certificate issuer and obligor); ACM International Ltd is the investment manager of the notional reference portfolio, not the obligor.

reserveReview.reviewer: Kimi P2 reserve cohort rc-2 (lead buidl-blackrock)
reserveReview.rationale: Midas identifies the live mAPOLLO exposure as an Apollo Crypto managed-yield strategy NAV. The signed final terms define a crypto-denominated stablecoin-yield strategy allocating dynamically across market-neutral spot, lending, arbitrage, derivatives, and token rewards, but does not disclose the current underlying assets, venue allocations, or custody providers. The slice is named to match the live chainlink-nav reserve adapter capture (assetLabel 'Apollo Crypto managed yield strategy NAV') so the reviewed classification overlays the captured exposure; it remains a bounded aggregate with the underlying allocation explicitly unresolved.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: Midas mAPOLLO product, final-terms, and transparency disclosures
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: The complete current underlying strategy allocation, venue exposures, and custody providers are undisclosed; the single NAV slice is the whole envelope, with the strategy internals intentionally unresolved.

custodyProfile.reviewer: Kimi P2 reserve cohort rc-2 (lead buidl-blackrock)
custodyProfile.uncertainty: Midas documents the mAPOLLO token, deposit and redemption vaults, and NAV data-feed contracts, and the final terms describe a dynamically allocated market-neutral strategy, so strategy assets are actively deployed and reused by design. The underlying strategy wallets, trading venues, custodians, provider shares, legal segregation, and bankruptcy-remoteness terms are not disclosed. The Midas Attestation Engine notarizes periodic NAV and proof-of-reserve checkpoints (vLayer notarization, LlamaRisk/Canary verification) but does not publish a position-level custody inventory.
